envelope.reason: answered: add does not check that the package resolves. Its documented order is add, then install (it prints 'next: npm i <package>', and the file-link workflow installs a local plugin after wiring it), so a resolve check would refuse the workflow add is built for. Nothing is left silent: add says what it wired and what to run next, and a config whose package is missing now fails every loading command with one line naming the package and the install command
